summary: SSO sign-in now verifies the identity provider's id_token (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce) and binds it to the authorization request with a nonce, instead of reading identity from an unverified token.

evidence: Agent-drafted disposition for a draft PR; maintainer review and approval are intentionally not claimed. Focused unit and e2e SSO tests pass (54) with real RS256 fixtures covering bad signature, wrong issuer, wrong audience, expired, nonce mismatch and unknown kid.
